1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the requests are specifically directed to filing proofs of claim documents;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records by transforming the data records into documents formatted according to specific requirements of each different bankruptcy organization, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations by electronically transmitting the formatted documents directly to filing systems of the respective bankruptcy organizations.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step includes adapting document formatting to comply with each court's specific filing requirements and procedures.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim and is received through a dedicated creditor portal;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records by transforming each data record into a proof of claim document formatted according to the specific filing requirements of the particular bankruptcy organization with which the proof of claim will be filed, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations by electronically submitting the formatted proofs of claim documents to the respective bankruptcy organizations' electronic filing systems.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step includes customizing each proof of claim to comply with the particular court's specific formatting, content, and procedural requirements.

8. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol and validating the authenticity of each creditor before accepting the requests.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site accessible only to registered creditors with verified credentials.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day, with each batch being transmitted to the appropriate bankruptcy organization based on the debtor's jurisdiction.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report specific to each creditor showing the status of proofs of claims filed on behalf of that creditor; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site and receiving the report in a format customized for that creditor's accounting systems.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed, including reasons related to incomplete data records or filing system unavailability.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim and storing the filing receipt in association with the corresponding creditor's account.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer that maintains separate connections to each bankruptcy organization's filing system.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record against a set of validation rules specific to the bankruptcy organization with which the proof of claim will be filed.
